status: RECORDED, NOT FIXED — owner decision 2026-09-21 section 10 forbids a PLAN-V2.2 during this qualification cycle
statement: The two grep-guard prohibitions of STORY-01-01 are declared NEGATIVE_INVARIANT, which requires GREEN at the story's parent. Whether they are green there is decided by the DEVELOPER, not by the plan: the parent has no `ledgerlock` package, so a test that carries the criterion in a file importing `ledgerlock` cannot be collected at the parent (RED_COLLECTION_BOUND_TO_STORY), while the same criterion in a file that imports nothing of the story collects and passes vacuously. Both are correct implementations of the criterion as written; only one can satisfy its declared proof mode.

w1_v2_1_run_1.outcome: the criteria landed in tests/test_skeleton.py, which imports ledgerlock at module level; at parent SHA ad2aa2b both were RED_COLLECTION_BOUND_TO_STORY -> PLAN_PRECONDITION_MISSING (owner PLAN) -> plan deadlock on STORY-01-01

plan_v2_diagnostic_run_1.outcome: the same two criteria were GREEN at the parent — the nop control at parent 73e0ec26 executed 6 tests, 2 green and 4 red, the 2 green being exactly these prohibitions — and STORY-01-01 passed on attempt 1

measured.difference: the plan text is identical in both runs; only the file the developer chose for the test differs

kernel_behaviour: correct in both runs. The gate named the owner (PLAN), routed the story to a plan deadlock rather than to the developer, spent 0 developer retries, and recorded 0 false pass and 0 false block. This is the V2 policy doing exactly what it exists to do; the defect is in the plan, not the kernel.
was_this_foreseen: Yes, and not acted on. The ownership audit of 2026-09-21 examined these two criteria, recorded that the prohibition holds only vacuously at a parent where the package does not exist, and judged them KEEP_CHANGE with a written rationale citing the diagnostic run's green measurement. That was the wrong call: a criterion whose proof mode depends on where a developer puts the test is not a stable obligation, and the audit had the evidence to say so. The conservative choice preserved a defect the same audit had already described.
what_a_correction_would_be: Out of scope this cycle, recorded for the owner: either (a) STORY-01-01 drops the two prohibitions and STORY-05-03 — the dedicated guard story, whose parent has a real package — keeps them, since they are the same two greps declared twice; or (b) the criteria state explicitly that an absent package satisfies the prohibition, so every correct implementation is green at the parent. Both trace to requirements §12.
severity: P1 for the workload plan; no kernel severity — no kernel defect is implicated
